records.name: Deadly Combo
records.effect: Adds a finishing area strike.
records.resourceNote: POWER retains its normal combo-point spending; this talent declares no second payment.

records.name: Devourer
records.effect: Repeatable kills build DMG.
records.resourceNote: The quest rewards kills, not resource spending itself. No additional point cost beyond POWER.

records.name: Focus
records.effect: Human shotgun becomes piercing; wolf gust leaves a tornado.
records.resourceNote: Uses the selected ultimate's normal charges/cooldown. It does not add combo-point spending.

records.name: Slash Flurry
records.effect: Replaces the follow-up with a multi-slash attack.
records.resourceNote: POWER is the setup action and spends points normally; the flurry adds no stated point cost.

records.name: Cleave
records.effect: Adds a damaging circular cleave.
records.resourceNote: Chance-gated, not combo-point-gated. Proc inheritance from special attack replacements is unverified.

records.name: Wide Attacks
records.effect: Improves attack reach and damage.
records.resourceNote: No activation or stored-point condition is stated.

records.name: Double Strike
records.effect: Empowers the follow-up and grants a combo point.
records.resourceNote: Generates 1 combo point. DASH supplies the setup, not a point payment.

records.name: Fan of Spikes
records.trigger: DASH in combat with a point
records.effect: Fires attack-scaled projectiles.
records.resourceNote: The talent spends 1 combo point on the dash effect. It competes with other point spenders.

records.name: Aggressive Defense
records.effect: Adds damage around Scarlet.
records.resourceNote: Uses DEFENSE's normal cooldown; no combo-point cost is stated.

records.name: Murderous Intent
records.effect: Supplies combo points and extends DEFENSE.
records.resourceNote: Grants 3 combo points. It does not increase the storage cap.

records.name: Shadow Strikes
records.trigger: Human DEFENSE → ATTACK or POWER hits
records.effect: Quest builds crit chance; completion adds crit damage.
records.resourceNote: No quest payment. A qualifying POWER still spends its normal combo points.

records.name: On the Hunt
records.effect: Marks a nearby enemy for subsequent damage.
records.resourceNote: Target-side payoff; no extra combo-point spend. Mark spread depends on kills.

records.name: Savagery
records.effect: Resource activity builds temporary DMG stacks.
records.resourceNote: Observes the transaction; does not consume extra points. Stacks expire without continued activity.

records.name: Adrenaline
records.effect: Human spending heals; wolf spending speeds attacks.
records.resourceNote: Rewards points spent elsewhere; does not spend a second set of points.

records.name: Evisceration
records.effect: Adds bleed according to points spent.
records.resourceNote: Uses POWER's existing payment. The talent does not impose an additional point cost.

records.name: Energy
records.effect: Adds storage and a POWER crit payoff for stored points.
records.resourceNote: Capacity +2; storage is not generation. POWER still spends points normally.

records.name: Explosive Rush
records.effect: Adds a SPECIAL effect to POWER.
records.resourceNote: The threshold checks stored points; POWER already consumes them. No separate extra payment is stated. Other SPECIAL talent inheritance needs testing.

records.name: Distant Explosions
records.effect: Changes targeting and damage; human bomb lands immediately without self-stun.
records.resourceNote: No extra combo-point cost. The human-specific behavior is distinct from the shared SPECIAL bonus.

records.name: Pyromania
records.effect: Adds ignite and SPECIAL crit chance.
records.resourceNote: No extra point cost or stored-resource gate stated.

records.name: Armor Break
records.effect: Applies a vulnerability debuff.
records.resourceNote: No added point payment; subsequent damage can benefit from the target debuff.

records.name: Pulverize
records.effect: Extends reach and empowers SPECIAL by spending a point.
records.resourceNote: The added bonus can consume 1 combo point. Reach is a separate benefit.

records.name: Shapeshifter
records.effect: Allows manual transformation and heals on use.
records.resourceNote: Reduces maximum health by 20%; this is a capacity penalty, not health spent per cast. Activation uses a cooldown.

records.name: True Instincts
records.effect: Human movement bonus; wolf maximum-health bonus.
records.resourceNote: Form-gated stat benefits, not a resource transaction.

records.name: Fiery Maw
records.effect: Adds reach, damage, and ignite.
records.resourceNote: No added combo-point cost. Ultimate availability still applies.

records.name: Bone Cracker
records.effect: Human cloud damages; wolf devour causes an explosion.
records.resourceNote: Enhances the chosen ultimate. Does not add point spending.

records.name: Pack Leader
records.effect: Human cloud heals allies; wolf devour shields them.
records.resourceNote: Healing and shield are outcomes, not a new combo-point payment.

records.name: Jinn Charge
records.effect: Adds a Jinn charge to the follow-up dash.
records.resourceNote: No enchantment or wish payment is declared for this proc. POWER setup still needs its normal availability.

records.name: Spectral Blades
records.effect: Blade retrieval adds an area flurry.
records.resourceNote: Retrieval is a positional condition, not a new resource spend. Do not assume the flurry is a normal ATTACK for every interaction.

records.name: Dive
records.effect: Converts the airborne attack into an area dive.
records.resourceNote: No extra enchantment payment is stated. Whether a transformed attack inherits every base-attack rule requires a gameplay check.

records.name: Spinning Strikes
records.effect: Follow-up spins increase further with enchantment.
records.resourceNote: Enchantment improves the effect; the underlying ATTACK can use enchantment. The card does not specify per-spin spending or an additional cost.

records.name: Slide Attack
records.trigger: ATTACK while SPECIAL blades are away
records.effect: Supplies an attack while the blades are flying.
records.resourceNote: Blade location is the gate. No enchantment spend is stated for the replacement slide.

records.name: Dream Scimitars
records.effect: Enchanted hits can generate Dream Shards.
records.resourceNote: Requires enchanted blades; attacks follow their normal enchantment use. This talent adds a shard reward, not another enchantment fee.

records.name: Shard Blades
records.effect: Improves enchanted attack reach and damage.
records.resourceNote: Enchantment is the condition and can be spent by base ATTACK. No additional talent cost is stated.

records.name: Leaping Strike
records.effect: Empowers the follow-up; enchantment adds another strike.
records.resourceNote: The first benefit does not require enchantment. Extra-strike spending granularity is not specified by the card.

records.name: Air Dash
records.effect: Allows an airborne dash and rewards it with attack speed.
records.resourceNote: Requires the action sequence and normal ability availability; no enchantment cost is added.

records.name: Acrobatics
records.effect: Generates enchantment through movement.
records.resourceNote: Each crossed enemy contributes enchantment. No enchantment spend is added.

records.name: Tornado Jump
records.effect: Creates a moving damage zone.
records.resourceNote: No enchantment or wish cost is stated.

records.name: Major Enchantment
records.effect: Regenerates enchantment while not attacking.
records.resourceNote: Passive generation has an opportunity cost: attacking interrupts the qualifying behavior. No resource is consumed.

records.name: Master Thief
records.effect: Can duplicate the chosen object.
records.resourceNote: An economy proc; it does not consume enchantment, shards, or a wish to duplicate the reward.

records.name: Swordjinn
records.effect: Adds a blade-catching POWER interaction.
records.resourceNote: No new enchantment payment is declared. Catching is a spatial requirement, not currency spending.

records.name: Enchanted Jinn
records.effect: Lets POWER spend enchantment for crit chance and expands storage.
records.resourceNote: Consumes up to 5 enchantment. Capacity rises by 5/10/15/20 with rarity; increased capacity is not generation.

records.name: Jinn's Fury
records.effect: Turns POWER into multiple hits.
records.resourceNote: No added enchantment spend. A separate Enchanted Jinn pick changes resource use; the base kit does not require it.

records.name: Jinn's Might
records.effect: Quest builds DMG; completion improves charge payoff.
records.resourceNote: Holding is a timing requirement, not enchantment spending. No wish cost is stated.

records.name: Healing Blades
records.effect: Retrieval heals nearby heroes according to hits.
records.resourceNote: Healing is a reward. No added enchantment, shard, or wish cost is stated.

records.name: Aerial Catch
records.effect: Catches progress an armor quest, then grant allied shields.
records.resourceNote: Requires a hit plus the airborne catch. No additional resource payment.

records.name: Sand Vortex
records.effect: Adds a pull and increases SPECIAL damage.
records.resourceNote: No enchantment or wish cost added. Ordinary SPECIAL can still build enchantment.

records.name: Jinniya's Gift
records.effect: Grants a wish charge and improves future talent rarity chances.
records.resourceNote: +1 TRAIT charge is a grant; the card does not say maximum wish capacity increases. Spending the wish remains a later action.

records.name: Wish of Omnipotence
records.effect: Adds a team cooldown window to wish casting.
records.resourceNote: Uses the wish's normal TRAIT charge. The talent does not charge a second wish or drain enchantment.

records.name: Wondrous Wishes
records.effect: Improves all three wish outcomes.
records.resourceNote: Normal wish-charge expenditure remains. These are wish variants, not blanket upgrades to ordinary POWER/SPECIAL/DEFENSE.

records.name: Infinite Wishes
records.effect: Grants wish charges and discounts Dream Wish.
records.resourceNote: +3 TRAIT charges; Dream Shard cost reduced 20/30/40/50%. It reduces an existing payment rather than removing it.

records.name: Dream Stride
records.trigger: Magic Carpet hits; or misses every target
records.effect: Carpet hits yield shards; an empty ride avoids its cooldown.
records.resourceNote: Generates 8/10/12/14 Dream Shards per hit. Magic Carpet has no stated shard cost; Dream Wish is the other ultimate.

records.name: Quick Ride
records.effect: Turns DASH into a brief damaging carpet ride.
records.resourceNote: No enchantment, wish or shard cost is declared. A carpet-shaped dash is not automatically an ULTIMATE cast.

scope: Published talent intent; resource and behavior labels are editorial classifications, not engine tracing.
